audience: small business owners and sales teams who run their contacts and sales in Keap

useCases.title: See new contacts and their details
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts with filters and ordering, and opens one contact in full. You can ask who was added recently.

useCases.title: Review open opportunities in the pipeline
useCases.text: The AI lists sales opportunities and opens single ones, then sums up what is open and who it belongs to.

useCases.title: Check open follow-up tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks, such as follow-ups and to-dos, and shows what is still open.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact with name, emails, phones and company, or updates the fields you name on an existing contact.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task or tag contacts
useCases.text: The AI creates a task linked to a contact, or applies a tag to one or more contacts. A tag can start an automation.

useCases.title: Review orders, subscriptions and products
useCases.text: The AI lists e-commerce orders, recurring subscriptions and catalog products, and summarizes them.
